rule_metadata.description: Comprehensive rules covering the echoing vibration (Qalqalah) of the five Qutb Jadd letters when vowelless, split into major (Kubra) and minor (Sughra) degrees.

theoretical_foundation.linguistic_definition: Qalqalah (قَلْقَلَة) literally means bouncing, echoing, or vibration.
theoretical_foundation.applied_tajweed_definition: A pronounced echoing vibration produced in the articulation point (Makhraj) when pronouncing any of the five vowelless Qalqalah letters, without mixing them with any of the three major vowels (Fathah, Kasrah, Dammah).
theoretical_foundation.the_five_letters: قطب جد (Qaf, Ta, Ba, Jeem, Dal)

sub_divisions.sughra: Qalqalah Sughra (Minor Qalqalah): Occurs when the Qalqalah letter is in the middle of a word with an original Sukoon. The bounce is subtle and controlled.
sub_divisions.kubra: Qalqalah Kubra (Major Qalqalah): Occurs when stopping (Waqf) on a Qalqalah letter at the end of a word (even if its original vowel was Fathah, Kasrah, or Dammah). The bounce is powerful and prominent.
sub_divisions.akbar: Qalqalah Akbar (Strongest Qalqalah): Occurs when pausing on a Qalqalah letter that carries a Shaddah at the end of a word (e.g., الحَقّ).

practical_examples.breakdown: Qaf with original Sukoon in the middle of the word; moderate bounce.
Pausing on Qaf at verse end creates a prominent major Qalqalah echo.
Pausing on Ba with Shaddah creates the strongest bouncing echo.

assessment_bank.question: What does 'Qalqalah' mean linguistically?
How many letters comprise the Qalqalah group?
Which of the following mnemonic phrases represents the Qalqalah letters?
What are the specific letters in 'قُطْبُ جَدٍّ'?
When does Qalqalah Sughra (Minor) occur?
options: When the Qalqalah letter is in the middle of a word with an original Sukoon
When stopping at a verse end
When a letter has a Shaddah

assessment_bank.question: When does Qalqalah Kubra (Major) occur?
options: When pausing (Waqf) on a Qalqalah letter at the end of a word
In the middle of a word

assessment_bank.question: What is Qalqalah Akbar (Strongest)?
options: Pausing on a Qalqalah letter that carries a Shaddah at the end of a word
Minor Qalqalah in middle of word

assessment_bank.question: What major error must be avoided when executing Qalqalah?
options: Allowing the echo to accidentally drift into one of the three main vowels (Fathah, Kasrah, Dammah)

assessment_bank.question: In the word 'يَخْلُقُونَ', what type of Qalqalah applies to the Qaf?
In 'قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ الْفَلَقِ', if you pause on 'الْفَلَقِ', what Qalqalah rule applies?
In 'وَتَبَّ', when pausing on the final Ba, what level of Qalqalah is produced?
Is Qalqalah triggered when a letter carries a clear vowel (Fathah, Kasrah, Dammah)?
options: No, the letter must be vowelless (Saakin) either inherently or due to stopping

assessment_bank.question: What is the physiological mechanism of Qalqalah in the vocal tract?
options: A sudden release of air pressure at the articulation point creating a clean bouncing acoustic wave
A nasal hum through the nose

assessment_bank.question: If a student echoes the letter Ba and accidentally makes it sound like 'Ba-h' or adds an 'ah' sound, what error is flagged?
options: Vowel contamination error (sounding like Fathah instead of a pure bounce)

assessment_bank.question: Which of the following words contains a Qalqalah Sughra?
Which of the following words produces Qalqalah Kubra when stopping?
Does Qalqalah apply to the letter Ta (ط) when vowelless?
options: Yes, Ta is one of the five Qutb Jadd letters

assessment_bank.question: Does Qalqalah apply to the letter Jeem (ج) when vowelless?
options: Yes, Jeem is part of قطب جد

assessment_bank.question: What is the primary pedagogical goal of Module 01 in Qalqalah?
options: To master the clean bouncing echo of the five Qutb Jadd letters across Sughra, Kubra, and Akbar degrees

assessment_bank.question: If a reciter pauses on 'مُحِيطٌ', what Qalqalah rule applies to the Ta?
What distinguishes Qalqalah Sughra from Qalqalah Kubra?
options: Sughra is internal to a word with permanent Sukoon; Kubra is created by pausing at a word end

assessment_bank.question: In 'مَجِيدٌ', when stopping on the Dal, what echo is produced?
How should an AI voice engine evaluate a Qalqalah Kubra pause on 'أَحَد'?

assessment_bank.question: Can Qalqalah occur across two separate words?
options: No, Qalqalah is internal to letter pronunciation when vowelless

assessment_bank.question: What is the phonetic danger of over-bouncing Qalqalah Sughra in the middle of a word?
options: It disrupts the smooth rhythmic flow of recitation

assessment_bank.question: In 'وَجَدَ', does Qalqalah apply to the Dal?
options: No, because the Dal carries an active Fathah vowel

assessment_bank.question: What is the rule when stopping on a Qalqalah letter that has a Shaddah (like 'الحَقّ')?
Why are the five Qutb Jadd letters uniquely suited for echoing?
options: Because of their combination of severe obstruction (Shiddah) and openness (jahr)

assessment_bank.question: If a student fails to bounce the Qaf in 'الْفَلَق' when stopping, what is the feedback?
options: Apply Qalqalah Kubra to cleanly echo the vowelless Qaf

assessment_bank.question: Summarize the core mechanics of Qalqalah:
options: Vowelless Qutb Jadd letters produce a crisp bouncing echo without vowel contamination, graded into Sughra, Kubra, and Akbar degrees

assessment_bank.question: In 'قَدْ أَفْلَحَ', what governs the Dal?

assessment_bank.question: In 'بِسْمِ اللَّهِ الرَّحْمَٰنِ الرَّحِيمِ', does any Qalqalah occur?
options: No Qalqalah letters appear with Sukoon in Fatihah opening

assessment_bank.question: What counting duration is assigned to Qalqalah?
options: It is an instantaneous percussive bounce rather than a timed vowel count like Madd

assessment_bank.question: How does Qalqalah behave during continuous Wasl recitation for Sughra letters?
options: The bounce remains present and crisp on the vowelless letter without pausing

assessment_bank.question: In 'طَارِقٌ', when pausing, what rule applies?

options: Clean, crisp separation of sound resembling a miniature acoustic rebound

assessment_bank.question: If a student bounces a non-Qalqalah letter like Meem or Seen, what error is flagged?
options: Unauthorized Qalqalah error (only the 5 Qutb Jadd letters bounce)

assessment_bank.question: In 'مُصِيطِرٌ', does Qalqalah apply to the Ta?
options: No, the Ta here is not part of Qutb Jadd

assessment_bank.question: How should an AI evaluation engine grade Qalqalah Akbar on 'الحَقّ'?
options: Mark as strong, prominent Shaddah Qalqalah bounce
